focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">编辑历史对话用于修正已经发送给 ZCode Agent 的消息。当你发现前一条指令写得不够准确、缺少文件路径、需要补充约束，或想调整任务方向时，可以直接编辑原消息，让 Agent 按新的上下文重新理解任务，而不用重新创建任务。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这对长任务尤其有用：你可以保留当前任务里的模型、工作区、分支和上下文，只修改关键指令，让后续执行围绕更新后的目标继续推进。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="enter-edit">找到编辑入口<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在对话历史记录中，将鼠标悬停在自己发送过的消息上。消息右侧会显示快捷操作区，其中铅笔图标就是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">编辑</strong> 入口；旁边也会保留复制等常用操作。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-edit-history-entry.webp" alt="ZCode 编辑历史入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="section">入口特点<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只出现在用户消息上</strong>：编辑入口用于修改你已经发送的指令，不会影响 Agent 的回复内容本身。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">作用于最近一轮</strong>：当前可编辑的是最后一轮的用户消息，任务运行中或有排队消息时暂不可编辑。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">适合快速纠偏</strong>：发现目标、路径或约束有误时，不需要重新开一个任务。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="interaction">编辑并重新发送<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击编辑按钮后，原消息会展开为可编辑输入框。你可以直接改写文字，也可以继续使用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">@</code> 引用文件、使用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code> 插入命令。确认无误后点击发送，ZCode Agent 会按更新后的消息继续处理任务；如果不想保留修改，点击取消即可退出编辑状态。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-edit-history-editing.webp" alt="ZCode 编辑历史状态" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="section-2">操作逻辑<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">进入编辑</strong>：点击用户消息右侧的铅笔图标。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">修改内容</strong>：在展开的输入框里调整原始指令，补充文件、路径、目标或限制条件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提交或取消</strong>：点击发送让 Agent 基于新指令继续推进；点击取消则保留原消息不变。</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="reset-chat-files">连同文件一起重置<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果上一轮不只是说错了话，Agent 还已经按错误的理解改了文件，编辑器里的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">对话 + 文件重置</strong> 会同时做两件事：把这一轮改动过的文件恢复原样，再用你改后的消息重新发送。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">万一有文件无法安全恢复（比如你在此期间手动改过它），ZCode 会提示「文件无法安全重置」，你可以选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅重置对话并发送</strong>。任务正在运行、正在压缩上下文，或者本轮压根没有可恢复的文件改动时，这个按钮不可用。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="queued-messages">修改待发送的消息<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Agent 还在回复时你就接着输入，这些内容会先进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">待发送消息</strong> 队列。发出去之前发现写错了，把鼠标移到队列面板里那一条上，点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">编辑</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">它的行为和「编辑历史对话」不同：不是在队列里原地改字，而是把整条内容连同附件一起 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">退回输入框</strong>，该条从队列中移除，你改完重新发送。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">两个前提：输入框里不能已经有草稿或正在上传的附件，否则会提示你先发送或清空；<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/compact</code> 这类压缩指令排在队列里时没有编辑入口，只能立即执行或删除。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="undo-files">撤销 Agent 改过的文件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">每轮回复下方的文件变更摘要里有 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">撤销</strong> 按钮，点击后会弹出确认窗口，先告诉你这一轮里哪些文件可以安全撤销、哪些不能、哪些会被忽略，确认后才真正写回。撤销之后按钮变成 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重新应用</strong>，可以再改回去。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这里有一条重要规则：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">要么全撤，要么都不撤</strong>。只要其中一个文件没法安全还原，ZCode 就一个都不动，不会让你落到改了一半的状态。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有三类改动没法从这里撤销：ZCode 没有留下改动前内容的文件、你在此期间手动编辑过的文件，以及 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">由终端命令造成的改动</strong>（这类会被直接忽略，需要你自己用 Git 处理）。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="usage-scenarios">使用场景<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">修正需求表达</strong>：发现前一条指令写错、遗漏目标或描述不够清楚。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">补充关键上下文</strong>：追加文件路径、错误日志、截图说明、接口参数等信息。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">调整任务方向</strong>：让 Agent 从“分析问题”改为“直接修复”，或从“实现功能”改为“先给方案”。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">减少重复对话</strong>：避免重新解释整段背景，让任务在同一个上下文里继续前进。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
